clauses.quote: All applicants for such employment will be notified in writing that their applications have been received
that they will be considered for summer or part time positions.
No Teacher shall be eligible to teach in these part-time programs after five (5) years of consecutive service unless there is no other qualified applicant available.
Summer program teachers will receive written notification of employment at least two (2) weeks before the end of the regular school year, where possible, even if so notified on a contingency basis.
the selection from among these individuals shall be in accordance with this Article.
clauses.subject_text: the selection from among these individuals

clauses.quote: The WTU and DCPS representatives shall hold meetings at least once a month, unless cancelled by mutual Agreement, to discuss school policies and problems relating to the implementation of the Agreement.
Any agreement reached on the interpretation of any part of the Agreement shall be reduced to writing and signed by DCPS or its designee and the WTU.
clauses.subject_text: Any agreement reached on the interpretation of any part of the Agreement

clauses.quote: The WTU and the DCPS shall each pay half of the full cost of the printing of this Agreement by a union printer for distribution to all Teachers.
The WTU shall choose the company or companies to provide tax-sheltered annuity coverage for employees in the ET teachers' bargaining unit.
Employees in the EG teachers' bargaining unit will continue to be covered by the carrier designated by the District of Columbia Government.
clauses.subject_text: Employees in the EG teachers' bargaining unit

clauses.quote: During the life of this Agreement, the WTU shall not cause, support, encourage or authorize any Teacher to participate in any cessation of work through slowdown, strike, work stoppage, or other similar activity.
the WTU’s agents shall, upon notification of such activity by the Chancellor, immediately and publicly declare as illegal all such activity and shall order Teachers to terminate such activity.
Failure of the WTU’s agents to do so shall constitute a violation of this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: Failure of the WTU’s agents to do so
